name: Shinokura Ao
source:
Ao and Ibuki were raised in the same orphanage, making her both Ibuki's childhood friend and bride thorn.

While they were kids, the two played around in the forest and stumbled into a werewolf, managing to survive by the skin of their teeth. Ao's sense of smell is sharper than most, allowing her to track the enemy effortlessly. That said, put a gun in her hand and she struggles to hit the side of a barn.

She's starting to develop romantic feelings for Ibuki, who remains blissfully unaware of the fact.

[Translated from [url=https://vampdoll.dojin.com/character/]the official description[/url]. Official translation can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000960/__The_Novel_Game/?beta=1]on Steam.[/url]]
